integrity: The result distinguishes the published binary connectedness theorem from the new diameter computation, records the odd-field diameter statement separately, and does not infer novelty from search failure alone.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to binary dimension two and, by orthogonal complementation, codimension two. It does not claim the diameter in intermediate dimensions. Finite enumeration is corroborative only; the infinite statement is proved symbolically.
title: Exact diameter three for binary two-dimensional LCD neighbor graphs
